parts.name: Base pairs
parts.quote: DNA bases pair up with each other, A with T and C with G, to form units called base pairs.

parts.name: Sugar-phosphate backbone
parts.quote: DNA is a double helix formed by base pairs attached to a sugar-phosphate backbone.

parts.name: Adenine
parts.quote: The information in DNA is stored as a code made up of four chemical bases: adenine (A), guanine (G), cytosine (C), and thymine (T).
